result.stdout:
ChartForgeX Markup CLI
Usage:
  chartforgex-markup validate <file> [--gantt-date-anchor YYYY-MM-DD]
  chartforgex-markup preview <file> [--output <preview.html>] [--gantt-date-anchor YYYY-MM-DD]
  chartforgex-markup export <file> --output <diagram.svg|diagram.html|diagram.png> [--gantt-date-anchor YYYY-MM-DD]
  chartforgex-markup emit <topology-file> --target csharp [--output <file.cs>]
  chartforgex-markup render <file> [--format text|svg|png|html] [--output <path>] [--diagram <id>]
                     [--scenario <id>] [--step <n|all>] [--columns <n>] [--ascii]
    Renders one diagram. Text draws architecture and topology diagrams for terminals; --step highlights a use case step.
    A file without fences is read as one chartforgex architecture diagram.
